```{r Load Libraries and Data, include=FALSE}

# load libraries
library(tidyverse)  # tidy data for data manipulation and visualization
library(tidybayes)  # tidy data for Bayesian models
library(knitr)      # data manipulation
library(cowplot)    # for nice plot layout
library(patchwork)  # for nice plot layout
library(brms)       # fitting Bayesian models
library(bayesplot)  # visualization of Bayesian models
library(rstan)      # bayesian models
library(cmdstanr)   # using the more-up-to-date cmdstanr instead of rstan as the underlying MCMC engine to avoid ***recursive gc invocation warnings
library(bayestestR) # helpful for some initial plotting 
library(see)        # the plots in the above package don't work without this

library(MetBrewer)  # pretty colors

# load custom functions
source("../02_functions/CustomFunctions.R")
                  
# load data
load("../01_data/03_derived/scaling_data.RData")

```

```{r remove outliers and normalize data}
filtered_data <- remove_outliers(data=scaling_data, vars=c("Spatial_AS","Gamma_stab"), quantile_cutoff = 0.997)
filtered_data <- normalize_min_max(data=filtered_data, var="Spatial_AS", epsilon = 0.0001, new_var_name = "Spatial_AS_normalized_exclusive_1")
```

```{r message=FALSE}

filtered_data$area.factor <- as.factor(filtered_data$Area)
filtered_data$div.factor <- as.factor(filtered_data$div)

# compute mean and se for variables of interest
summary_stats <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(area.factor, div.factor) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    #Beta_div
    Beta.div_mean = mean(Beta_div, na.rm = TRUE),
    Beta.div_se = sd(Beta_div, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    #Spatial_AS
    Spatial.AS_mean = mean(Spatial_AS, na.rm = TRUE),
    Spatial.AS_se = sd(Spatial_AS, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    #Gamma_stab
    Gamma.stab_mean = mean(Gamma_stab, na.rm = TRUE),
    Gamma.stab_se = sd(Gamma_stab, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  #reshape into longer format
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(area.factor, div.factor), 
               names_to = c("metric", ".value"), 
               names_sep = "_")
```

```{r plotting settings}
hokusai.palette <- met.brewer("Hokusai1", 3)

base_theme <- theme_tidybayes() + 
  panel_border()+
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"))
```

```{r Fig-S1-panel-A}
Fig.S1A <- ggplot(
  summary_stats %>% filter(metric %in% c("Beta.div", "Spatial.AS")),
  aes(x = area.factor, y = mean, colour = metric, group = metric)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(
    ~ div.factor,
    labeller = labeller(
      div.factor = function(x) paste0("Species richness:\n", x)
    )
  ) +
  xlab("Spatial Extent") +
  ylab("Mean (± SE)") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Beta.div" = hokusai.palette[1],
      "Spatial.AS" = hokusai.palette[2],
      "Gamma.stab" = hokusai.palette[3]
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Beta Diversity",
      "Spatial Asynchrony",
      "Gamma Stability"
    ),
    breaks = c("Beta.div", "Spatial.AS", "Gamma.stab"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  base_theme
```

```{r Fig-S1-panel-B}
Fig.S1B <- ggplot(

) +

```

```{r Fig-S1-legend}
legend_plot <- ggplot(
  tibble(
    metric = factor(
      c("Beta.div", "Spatial.AS", "Gamma.stab"),
      levels = c("Beta.div", "Spatial.AS", "Gamma.stab")
    ),
    x = 1,
    y = 1
  ),
  aes(x = x, y = y, colour = metric)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Beta.div" = hokusai.palette[1],
      "Spatial.AS" = hokusai.palette[2],
      "Gamma.stab" = hokusai.palette[3]
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Beta Diversity",
      "Spatial Asynchrony",
      "Gamma Stability"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black")
  )

shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)
```

<div class="figure-frame">

```{r Fig-S1-combine, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8.3, fig.height=10.5, out.width="100%"}
Fig.S1 <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  shared_legend,
  (
    (Fig.S1A) / (Fig.S1B) +
      plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
      theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"))
  ),
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.08, 1)
)

Fig.S1
```

</div>

**Figure S1: The average change in beta diversity, spatial asynchrony, and gamma stability (± standard error) across spatial extents for three levels of planted species richness.** Spatial extent corresponds to the number of aggregated communities. Summary statistics are calculated from raw values. **A.** The average change in beta diversity and spatial asynchrony across spatial extents. **B.** The average change in spatial asynchrony and gamma stability across spatial extents. The y-axes are scaled separately between panels because beta diversity, spatial asynchrony, and gamma stability differ in their numerical ranges.

```{r import model 1}
SA_quantile<-readRDS("../04_bayesian_analysis/models/SA_quantile.rds")
```

```{r}
filtered_data_SA <- filtered_data %>%
  select(Beta_div, Spatial_AS_normalized_exclusive_1, Area, div) 
```

```{r}
SA_prediction <- filtered_data_SA %>% 
  add_epred_draws(SA_quantile, ndraws = 5000)
```

```{r Fig.S2A, warning=FALSE}

# define colour palette
hokusai.palette <- met.brewer("Hokusai1", 7)

Fig.S2A <- SA_prediction %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Beta_div, y = Spatial_AS_normalized_exclusive_1, group = Area, color = Area)) + # group by Area to avoid messy lines
  # Add raw data points
  geom_point(data = filtered_data, aes(x = Beta_div,
                                      y = Spatial_AS_normalized_exclusive_1,
                                      color = Area),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.1, size = 1, shape = 19) +
  # Add the ribbons with a gray fill for uncertainty
  stat_lineribbon(aes(y = .epred), .width = 0.95, fill = 'gray') +  # define '.width' for custom credible interval; fill = "gray"
  # Faceting
  facet_grid(.~ div, labeller = labeller(
    div = function(x) paste0("Species richness:\n", x))) +
  # Axis labels
  xlab("Beta Diversity") +
  ylab("Normalized Spatial Asynchrony") +
  # Color scale for 'Area'
  scale_color_gradientn(name = "Spatial\nExtent", colors = hokusai.palette) +
  # Modify axes's appearance
  rawdata_theme + 
  theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "null"))

```

```{r Fig.S2B, warning=FALSE}

Fig.S2B <- SA_prediction %>% # specify number of draws only during initial stages of plotting
  mutate(div.factor = factor(div, levels = c(1, 4, 8))) %>% # group by div, and reorder levels for legend
  ggplot(aes(x = Beta_div, 
             y = Spatial_AS_normalized_exclusive_1, 
             group = div.factor, 
             linetype = div.factor)) + # ensures that linetype is mapped to div.factor
  # Add raw data points
  geom_point(data = filtered_data, aes(x = Beta_div, y = Spatial_AS_normalized_exclusive_1),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.1,
  size = 1,
  shape = 19,
  colour = "black") +
  # Add the ribbons with a gray fill for uncertainty
  stat_lineribbon(aes(y = .epred, linetype = div.factor), #ensures that linetype is mapped to div.factor
                  .width = 0.95, # width of the credible interval
                  fill = 'gray', # color of the ribbon
                  color = 'black') + # ensures the lines are shown in the legend 
  # Faceting
  facet_grid(.~ Area, labeller = labeller(
    Area = function(x) paste0("Spatial\nExtent:\n", x))) +
  # Axis labels
  xlab("Beta Diversity") +
  ylab("Normalized Spatial Asynchrony") +
  # Manual linetype scale and black line color
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Species\nRichness", values = c("solid", "dashed", "dotted")) + # legend specifications
  # Chop plot to zoom in where we want to focus
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 2)) + 
  # Modify axes's appearance
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2))+ # reduce number of x axis ticks
  rawdata_theme +
  theme(legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"))
  

```

<div class="figure-frame">

```{r Fig-S2-combine, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8.3, fig.height=10.5, out.width="100%"}
# Combine SA raw-data figure

FigS2 <- (Fig.S2A/Fig.S2B) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 20))

FigS2
```

</div>

**Figure S2: The relationship between β-diversity and normalized spatial asynchrony across spatial extents for three levels of planted species richness, including raw data points.** Lines show posterior mean predictions, and ribbons represent 95% credible intervals, indicating uncertainty in the fitted mean relationship. **A.** The relationship across the full range of β-diversity. The levels of planted species richness are represented in the facets. **B.** The relationship for a reduced range of β-diversity that could be replicated across all species richness treatments. Spatial extent is represented in the facets.

</br>
</br>
